settings.name: Mark
settings.title: A dream come true
settings.body: I’m a West Ham fan and it was my dream to get this cup. The size and detail are spot on. I will treasure it.

settings.name: James T.
settings.title: Incredible detail for a 1:1 replica
settings.body: Ordered this as a surprise for my dad, a lifelong football fan. The size and finish are stunning, and engraving our family name on it made it really personal. It now has pride of place in his study.

settings.name: Daniel O.
settings.title: Exactly like the trophy on TV
settings.body: I was nervous ordering something this big online, but it arrived perfectly packed and looks identical to the cup I've seen lifted on TV. Communication throughout was excellent.

settings.hero_desc: A characterful figurine award - a child holding up a bright idea - finished in metallic gold, silver or bronze on an engraved base. A warm, memorable trophy for innovation, creativity and "bright idea" recognition programmes.
settings.perso_placeholder: Award name, recipient, finish (gold/silver/bronze) and base plaque
settings.s1_body: Some achievements deserve a trophy with a little more heart. This figurine captures the spark of a new idea and turns it into a keepsake your winners actually want on their desk. Available in metallic gold, silver and bronze finishes with an engraved plaque, it is ideal for innovation awards, creativity programmes and "idea of the year" style recognition - run as a tiered set or a single standout prize.
settings.case_body: Created as an innovation-award series, these figurines gave a recognition programme a warm, distinctive identity - tiered in gold, silver and bronze, each with its own engraved category and recipient.
settings.case_quote: Winners loved them - far more personality than a standard cup. They're proudly on desks across the office.
settings.prov_p: Recognition lands hardest when it feels human. A figurine that captures the joy of a new idea makes the moment memorable in a way a generic trophy never will.
